mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket t JOIN customer c ON c.id=t.customer_id WHERE t.public_id=#{publicId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT public_id,subject,description,status,created_at FROM ticket WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT public_id,author_role,content,created_at FROM ticket_message WHERE ticket_public_id=#{publicId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT public_id,author_role,content,created_at FROM ticket_message WHERE ticket_public_id=#{ticketId} AND public_id=#{messageId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET status=CASE WHEN status='RESOLVED' THEN 'ASSIGNED' ELSE status END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND status<>'CLOSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ticket(public_id, customer_id, session_public_id, source_action_id, subject, description) VALUES(#{publicId},#{customerId},#{sessionId},#{actionId},#{subject},#{description})
mapper.select: SELECT public_id, subject, description, status, created_at FROM ticket WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT public_id, subject, description, status, created_at FROM ticket WHERE source_action_id=#{actionId} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT FROM ticket t JOIN customer c ON c.id=t.customer_id WHERE t.status=#{status} ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET status=#{targetStatus}, assigned_to=COALESCE(assigned_to,#{operator}), resolution_note=CASE WHEN #{resolutionNote} IS NULL OR #{resolutionNote}='' THEN resolution_note ELSE #{resolutionNote} END WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND status=#{currentStatus}
